name: Available Books Report
query:
SELECT
    book_name AS "Book Name:Data:200",
    isbn AS "ISBN:Data:150",
    author AS "Author:Link/Author:180",
    category AS "Category:Link/Book Category:180",
    total_copies AS "Total Copies:Int:120",
    available_copies AS "Available Copies:Int:140",
    status AS "Status:Data:120"
FROM
    `tabBook`
WHERE
    available_copies > 0
    
ORDER BY
    book_name
